text:
Maya Patel: Quick pulse on dedicated capacity for AcroHealth this week — sharing the signals we care about (GPU hours, saturation, queue depth, spend). TL;DR: usage up, a mid-week saturation spike caused a short backlog, small error spike from 2 model OOMs.

Tom Benson: FYI numbers I pulled from the pool: GPU hours this week = 18,400 (12% ↑ w/w). Avg pool sat = 86% during 09:00-17:00 PST, peak 98% at 2024-11-13T15:10:22Z. Avg queue depth = 14 reqs, p95 queue wait = 1.8s. p95 token latency = 220ms. Error rate = 0.9% (mostly 507/ooms + a few 503s). Spend week-to-date = $22.4k.

Lina Gomez: Noted. Renewal in ~6 weeks — this trend pushes them into an expansion conversation. If we keep >80% sat they'll ask for more reserved hours or burst. I can pre-send a 10% buffer proposal.

Rajiv Menon: I dug into the OOMs — two model variants (acrh-health-v2-int8 and acrh-ner-lr) tripped memory on long prompts. Looks like quantization profile mismatch after their recent model switch. I can roll a targeted quant tweak and restrict max_seq for that route.

Tom Benson: The Wed spike lines up with a preemptible node churn at 15:07 — autoscaler removed 3 preemptibles then re-added slower than traffic ramped. I bumped scale cooldowns and added a 2-node warm pool Thu 07:30; pool sat dropped to 63% post-change.

Jared Lee: I temporarily added 1 GPU to the burst pool for their weekend demo (CS-PRIORITY tag) — document CS-4247 created.

Maya Patel: Action items: 1) Rajiv deploy quant patch & max_seq safeguard by Fri EOD; 2) Tom keep the 2-node warm pool and monitor autoscaler logs for 48h; 3) Lina prepare a short proposal (10% reserved buffer + burst pricing) and a one-slide impact calc for renewal outreach. Lina, please confirm you'll send the draft.

Lina Gomez: Confirmed. I'll share a draft deck by Mon 09:00 PT. Will include cost delta and perf uplift estimates.

Tom Benson: Also observed client-side behavior — a sudden bump in parallel streams from AcroHealth app correlates with queue depth. I flagged the SDK team; asked AcroHealth to throttle concurrency to 6 streams for the demo window.

Rajiv Menon: Deploying a safe quant tweak to canary (2 hosts) now, will monitor mem and 95p latency. If green, promote to blue by Fri noon.

CS Bot: [automated] Ticket CS-4247 created: "AcroHealth capacity review — warm pool + quantization patch". Assigned to: Rajiv, Tom, Lina.

Maya Patel: Nice. Risk note: if Sat stays >85% during business hours we should surface a renewal upsell and prepare SOW for dedicated expansion. Lina — can you include a scenario with SLOs & pricing so AE has options?

Lina Gomez: Will add SLO-based options + a tiered pricing table.

Jared Lee: I'll leave the extra burst GPU in place until Mon 12:00 PT and then revert unless we hear new asks.

Tom Benson: I'll post autoscaler logs to the ticket and set an alert rule for >90% sat for 3 consecutive 10m windows.

Maya Patel: Perfect. We'll reconvene Tue morning for live status. Thanks team :thumbsup:
